newsitem.title: UK: Futuremedia unit files for bankruptcy.
newsitem.headline: Futuremedia unit files for bankruptcy.

text.p: ARUNDEL, West Sussex, England - Futuremedia Plc said Tuesday its German subsidiary, LaserMedia has filed for bankruptcy.
The company said it has written off its investment of PDS 261,000 ($425,000) in LaserMedia.
Claus Stratmann, the general manager for LaserMedia, has resigned from the board of Futuremedia, the company said.
Futuremedia is a creator and distributor of interactive multimedia training products and parent company of its LaserMedia subsidiaries.
